entities.name: Personal Knowledge Hub
observations: Master data warehouse for all personal life questions
4-layer architecture: Interface → Agent → MCP → Data Sources
Query-first design: NEVER cache, ALWAYS query live
Sources self-index — no centralized duplication
Steering files define routing logic, NOT data
Adding a new source = adding a MCP connector, nothing else

entities.name: NotebookLM
observations: Priority 1 source — primary knowledge base (RAG)
2 Google accounts, separated by notebook type
Covers ALL domains
Best for: factual questions, procedures, reference material
Read-only — cannot write back

entities.name: Notion
observations: Priority 2 source — structured data (pages, databases)
Mixed personal + professional content — must filter to personal only
Best for: structured info, lists, databases, detailed procedures

entities.name: Alithya Knowledge RAG
observations: Priority 3 source — personal documents from Dropbox/AAA_PRIVATE_LIFE
Remote server on PC Alithya (192.168.2.56:8080) — must be running
Hybrid search: semantic embeddings + BM25 + cross-encoder reranking
Best for: PDFs, avis de cotisation, factures, contrats, relevés fiscaux, documents d'identité

entities.name: TickTick
observations: Priority 4 source — tasks, recurring reminders, habits
Best for: 'What do I need to do?', deadlines, reminders
IMPORTANT: Pour requêtes par date, utiliser full_sync puis filtrer manuellement (tasks_of_today ne résout pas les récurrences)

entities.name: Gmail
observations: Priority 5 source — emails, attachments, confirmations
Best for: confirmations, official dates, correspondence history
Use Gmail search syntax: from:, subject:, newer_than:

entities.name: Telegram
observations: Priority 6 source — messages personnels, conversations avec Abir, notes à soi-même
Timestamps returned in UTC — ALWAYS convert to America/Toronto before displaying
Best for: échanges avec conjointe, notes rapides envoyées à soi-même, conversations informelles

entities.name: Browser Bookmarks
observations: Priority 7 source — 7260 Chrome + 2454 Edge bookmarks
Best for: retrouver un lien sauvegardé, même ancien
Local search, no internet needed

entities.name: Excel

Best for: financial amounts, budget tracking, account balances

entities.name: Routing Rules
observations: User-directed routing has HIGHEST priority — if user says where to look, go there first
Maximum 3 sources for non-exploration queries
For exploration type: query ALL sources in parallel
NEVER skip NotebookLM for factual/procedure questions
If primary sources return nothing: try fallback sources before saying 'not found'
factual → NotebookLM + Notion (fallback: Gmail, Telegram)
action → TickTick + Notion (fallback: NotebookLM)
document → NotebookLM + Gmail + Alithya RAG (fallback: Notion)
timeline → Gmail + Notion + TickTick (fallback: NotebookLM, Telegram)
procedure → NotebookLM + Notion
link/reference → Bookmarks + NotebookLM (fallback: Telegram, Gmail)
conversation → Telegram + Gmail (fallback: Notion)

entities.name: Data Principles
observations: Data is dynamic — NEVER cache, ALWAYS query fresh
No duplication — data lives in ONE authoritative location
Source citation is MANDATORY for every fact
Contradictions are valuable — present both, suggest which is newer, ask user
Privacy: reference sensitive data by key, not by value
If source unreachable: inform user, use fallbacks, NEVER fabricate
The agent learns ROUTING, not DATA — facts belong in sources, not steering files

entities.name: Domains
